newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Cagamas to issue 550 mln rgt notes, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Cagamas to issue 550 mln rgt notes, bonds.

text.p: Malaysia's national mortgage corporation, Cagamas Bhd, announced on Thursday that it will issue two-month notes and two-and-a-half year fixed rate bonds totalling 550 million ringgit next week.
It said in a statement that bids for the 350-million ringgit notes will be accepted on the basis discount.
Bidding for the 200-million ringgit bonds will be on basis of yield, it said. The bond issue has been classified as Tier-1 under Malaysia's two-tier banking system.
Dealers said the issues will roll over funds maturing from a large Bank Negara bill issue next week.
All notes issues by Cagamas qualify as liquid assets. Malaysian banks need to maintain a portion of their deposits in liquid or mainly government assets.
